description: This file defines the main API endpoints for a Personal Journal application using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for health checks, CRUD operations for journal entries, file upload handling, and middleware setup. The code integrates database session management, static file serving, and request parsing for multipart form data, representing the core source code of the API backend.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: The main FastAPI application instance used to define routes and middleware.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify service is running.

methods.name: list_journal_entries()
methods.description: Retrieves all journal entries, ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: get_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to fetch", ge=1) )
methods.description: Fetches a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: create_journal_entry( title: str = Form(..., description="Title for the journal entry (1..200 chars)"), content: str = Form(..., description="Content/body for the entry (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file"), )
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry with optional image upload.

methods.name: update_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to update", ge=1), title: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated title (1..200 chars)"), content: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated content (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file to replace existing"), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form(False, description="Set true to remove existing image"), )
methods.description: Updates existing journal entry details, including optional image replacement or removal.

methods.name: delete_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to delete", ge=1) )
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by ID.
